output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-inflicted by the quota metric. Genuine first-contact demand rose only 4%. Reopens, split tickets and duplicates exploded, and quick-win picking displaced complex tickets. The Billing-Compliance pod has no quota and stayed stable. Team C's partial rule change cut its reopens. The reopen-rate artifact is ruled out by the audit log. Capacity was flat and closes per agent rose, so effort and headcount are not the cause. Payroll is a minor share of the backlog. Escalated bugs may contribute, which is unconfirmed. Suspend the quota in favor of quality measures and classify the aged complex tickets. Do not escalate the quota or commit permanent headcount now.
